title: AI invoice reconciliation add-on for mid-market ecommerce operators
business_task: Analyze whether a small B2B SaaS team should launch an AI invoice reconciliation add-on for mid-market ecommerce operators in Vietnam.
company_context: The company already sells an order and inventory operations SaaS to ecommerce merchants. It has 18 engineers, 4 customer success staff, and a small sales team. Current customers complain about manual invoice matching between marketplaces, payment gateways, shipping providers, and accounting exports.
available_facts: Current product serves about 120 paying merchants.
The team has access to order, payout, shipping, and SKU data through existing integrations.
Five existing customers asked for faster invoice and payout reconciliation during the last quarter.
The team can build a prototype in 6 to 8 weeks, but production-grade accounting exports may take longer.
Sales team says customers resist add-ons priced above 20 percent of their current subscription unless the ROI is obvious.
Support team is already stretched during monthly closing periods.
constraints: Do not assume external market size numbers.
Focus on a testable launch decision for the next quarter.
The company wants low operational complexity and low support burden.
